description: This file defines the ScreenController class, a final class responsible for managing a WebView inside an iOS app, handling navigation, snapshots, debug status, and interaction callbacks within a web-based UI.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class acting as a controller for a WebView, managing navigation, state, debug info, and callbacks.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to a specified URL string, handling URLs securely.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current WebView content based on the current URL string and trust settings.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets and reloads to a default blank canvas.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the debug status overlay in the WebView.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug overlay's title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies current debug status settings to the WebView.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Sets the state JSON for the home canvas and applies it.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the WebView to render the home state.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the A2UI to be ready within a timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string in the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of WebView content as a PNG and returns base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Takes a snapshot in specified format and quality, returning a base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotImage
methods.description: Creates a UIImage snapshot of the WebView content.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Associates a WKWebView with the controller and initializes it.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches the WKWebView from the controller.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted canvas UI URL.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Parses the body of an A2UI action from various formats to a dictionary.
